patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Elastic Observability and Honeycomb share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Elastic Observability only if your buying job matches “Observability on Elastic Cloud — Hosted Standard from $99/mo (120 GB / 2 zones); Serverles” rather than Honeycomb's shape. Choose Honeycomb only if your buying job matches “High-cardinality event/trace observability — Free; Pro from $150/mo; Enterprise custom. Do” rather than Elastic Observability's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Elastic Observability is shaped for Observability on Elastic Cloud — Hosted Standard from $99/mo (120 GB / whereas Honeycomb is shaped for High-cardinality event/trace observability — Free; Pro from $150/mo; E. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Elastic Observability and Honeycomb share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Elastic Observability is Observability on Elastic Cloud — Hosted Standard from $99/mo (120 GB / 2 zones); Serverless Observability usage from ~$0.07–$0.09/GB ingest;; Honeycomb is High-cardinality event/trace observability — Free; Pro from $150/mo; Enterprise custom. Does not outrank Datadog 8.6..
- Researched limits: Elastic Observability — This entity is Elastic Observability on Cloud — not “Elasticsearch search product only”; Honeycomb — Not a Datadog-style infrastructure monitoring suite — high-cardinality events/traces are the job.

Limitations — Elastic Observability: This entity is Elastic Observability on Cloud — not “Elasticsearch search product only”; $99 Hosted Standard is a small 120 GB / 2-zone floor; real TCO follows resources; Honeycomb: Not a Datadog-style infrastructure monitoring suite — high-cardinality events/traces are the job; Does not outrank Datadog (8.6).

Poor-fit cases: Elastic Observability is a poor fit when that limitation bites: This entity is Elastic Observability on Cloud — not “Elasticsearch search product only” · Honeycomb is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a Datadog-style infrastructure monitoring suite — high-cardinality events/traces are the job · Avoid Elastic Observability if you actually need Honeycomb's motion (High-cardinality event/trace observability — Free; Pro from $150/mo; Enterprise )
